raids.name: Kaiju Tentacruel
raids.blurb: The harbor pollution has made this Tentacruel huge. Break its three shields; it calls Tentacool at each.

phases.text: The harbor boils. The Tentacruel rears up out of the water!

approaches.label: Face it alone
approaches.text: Take it on with your own team.

approaches.label: Call the harbor boats
approaches.text: The fishing boats harry it from the water first (the boss starts 25% weaker).

hazard.text: The polluted harbor water burns your Pokémon!

raids.name: Sleeping Giant
raids.blurb: A huge Snorlax blocks the path. It wakes up angry when it gets hurt.

phases.text: The giant wakes up and gets serious!

raids.name: Pack Leader
raids.blurb: The leader of a fiery pack. It howls and speeds up when it is hurt.

phases.text: The pack leader howls! Its speed rises.

raids.name: Storm Caller
raids.blurb: A Gyarados raging inside its own storm. Break the shield before the big wave.

telegraph.text: Gyarados is gathering a giant wave!

surge.text: The rain surges! Water moves hit harder!

raids.name: Crystal Golem
raids.blurb: Regirock's stone shell cracks only after a shield falls.

phases.text: The crystals shine! The golem hardens.

raids.name: Sandstorm Tyrant
raids.blurb: Two shields, one rage. Hit hard, hit smart.

phases.text: The tyrant stomps and the sand rises!

surge.text: The sand surges! Rock moves hit harder!

hazard.text: The sandstorm's grit tears at your Pokémon!

raids.name: Dragon's Ascent
raids.blurb: Dragonite takes a second swing when it is nearly beaten.

hazard.text: The thin air saps your Pokémon!

raids.name: Steel Mind
raids.blurb: Metagross thinks ahead: shields, a charged attack and a bonus move.

phases.text: The steel mind calculates your weakness.

telegraph.text: Metagross is calculating a crushing blow!

raids.name: Sky Pillar Apex
raids.blurb: The apex raid: three shields, three phases, a charged attack, a bonus move and a timer.

telegraph.text: Rayquaza is gathering the sky's power!

surge.text: The sky surges! Dragon moves hit harder!

raids.name: Garden Guardian
raids.blurb: Venusaur shrugs off early hits behind a wall of leaves.

phases.text: The flowers bloom! Its defenses rise.

puzzle.text: Its thorny guard only breaks to the right pattern of types.

raids.name: Venom Reef
raids.blurb: Toxapex hides behind a toxic shell.

raids.name: Midnight Haunt
raids.blurb: Gengar fades in and out of the dark and winds up a Shadow Ball.

surge.text: The dark surges! Ghost moves hit harder!

raids.name: Sand Sovereign
raids.blurb: Garchomp rules the dunes and strikes again when cornered.

phases.text: A sandstorm answers the sovereign's roar.

raids.name: Mind Zenith
raids.blurb: Mewtwo reads every move and answers with a crushing blow.

telegraph.text: Mewtwo is focusing a crushing blow!

puzzle.text: It calculates every blow. Hit it with the pattern it cannot predict.

raids.name: The Storm Sovereign
raids.blurb: A vast shape in the storm. You cannot beat it yet, but you can learn how it fights.

telegraph.text: The Storm Sovereign is gathering the storm!

raids.name: The Storm Sovereign: Reckoning
raids.blurb: The final confrontation. It remembers how you fought it before.

telegraph.text: The Storm Sovereign is gathering everything!

raids.name: Blight on the Ridge
raids.blurb: A regional threat has cut the ridge road. Scout first, or charge in.

phases.text: The threat howls across the ridge!

approaches.label: Scout the ridge
approaches.text: Pay for intel: the boss is weaker and you get more time.

approaches.label: Charge in
approaches.text: No prep: a tougher boss, a bigger prize.

raids.name: Harbor Storm
raids.blurb: A storm Pokémon has closed the harbor. How you prepare changes the fight.

approaches.label: Gather intel
approaches.text: Weaker boss, more time.

approaches.label: Sail in now
approaches.text: A tougher boss and a bigger prize.

surge.text: The storm surges! Water moves hit harder!

hazard.text: A heavy swell crashes over your Pokémon!

raids.name: Rival at the Den
raids.blurb: A rival trainer is already fighting this Pokémon when you arrive.

approaches.label: Help your rival
approaches.text: Fight beside them: the boss is already hurt, but the prize is shared.

approaches.label: Race for the last hit
approaches.text: The boss is hurt, but the clock is short.

approaches.label: Leave them to it
approaches.text: Walk away.

raids.name: Rival at the Summit
raids.blurb: Your rival has cornered a mighty Pokémon on the summit.

approaches.label: Fight together
approaches.text: Fight beside them: the boss is already hurt, but the prize is shared.

approaches.label: Race for the last hit
approaches.text: The boss is hurt, but the clock is short.

approaches.label: Let them have it
approaches.text: Walk away.

raids.name: Mirror Anomaly
raids.blurb: The arena bends: the weakness shifts every few turns and the terrain hums.

raids.name: Static Anomaly
raids.blurb: A distorted arena where one type surges and healing fails.

surge.text: The sky surges! Flying moves hit harder!

puzzle.text: The static hides a pattern. Hit it in order to break the defence.

raids.name: Umbra Corps Lab
raids.blurb: A cold lab hums behind a false warehouse wall. A Shadow Pokémon paces in a cage at the back.

phases.text: Alarms ring. Lab guards pour in and the Shadow haze thickens!

approaches.label: Slip in through the vents
approaches.text: Quiet and slow: the boss starts weakened and you see its moves coming, but you pay for gear.

approaches.label: Break down the front door
approaches.text: No prep and every guard awake: a tougher boss, a bigger prize.

approaches.label: Free the caged Pokémon first
approaches.text: Free the prisoners before the boss: the fight is shorter and the prize smaller, and the freed ones join the draft.

raids.name: Umbra Spire
raids.blurb: Dr. Vesper's refinery spire. The Shadow process runs on every floor.

phases.text: Dr. Vesper calls reinforcements: a new wave rushes the floor!
The core flares. The Shadow haze surges!

approaches.label: Slip in through the vents
approaches.text: Quiet and slow: the boss starts weakened and you see its moves coming, but you pay for gear.

approaches.label: Break down the front door
approaches.text: No prep and every guard awake: a tougher boss, a bigger prize.

approaches.label: Free the caged Pokémon first
approaches.text: Free the prisoners before the boss: the fight is shorter and the prize smaller, and the freed ones join the draft.

raids.name: Gilded Talon Camp
raids.blurb: Poachers' cages line a canyon camp. Captain Rook's handlers guard the crates.

phases.text: The handlers crack their whips and the caged Pokémon scream!

approaches.label: Slip in through the vents
approaches.text: Quiet and slow: the boss starts weakened and you see its moves coming, but you pay for gear.

approaches.label: Break down the front door
approaches.text: No prep and every guard awake: a tougher boss, a bigger prize.

approaches.label: Free the caged Pokémon first
approaches.text: Free the prisoners before the boss: the fight is shorter and the prize smaller, and the freed ones join the draft.

raids.name: Gilded Talon Vault
raids.blurb: A fortified vault where the best stolen Pokémon are sealed for the lab.

phases.text: Captain Rook bolts the doors. Armoured handlers rush in!
The vault alarm triggers the Shadow process early!

approaches.label: Slip in through the vents
approaches.text: Quiet and slow: the boss starts weakened and you see its moves coming, but you pay for gear.

approaches.label: Break down the front door
approaches.text: No prep and every guard awake: a tougher boss, a bigger prize.

approaches.label: Free the caged Pokémon first
approaches.text: Free the prisoners before the boss: the fight is shorter and the prize smaller, and the freed ones join the draft.

raids.name: Titan Steelix
raids.blurb: A mountain of iron rises out of the ground. Quick strikes barely scratch it.

phases.text: The titan rears up and the ground shakes!

titan.text: The titan shrugs off most of the blow! Topple it: sleep, paralysis, freeze, or lower its Defense.

raids.name: Titan Wailord
raids.blurb: A living island rolls in the surf. Only a toppled titan takes real damage.

telegraph.text: The titan gathers a mighty wave!

titan.text: The titan is too vast to hurt! Topple it first.

hazard.text: Waves from the titan slosh over your Pokémon!

raids.name: Titan Rhyperior
raids.blurb: A walking cliff. It only feels a hit when it is off balance.

phases.text: The titan stomps and rock rains down!

telegraph.text: The titan winds up a crushing blow!

titan.text: The titan barely feels it! Topple it: sleep, paralysis, freeze, or lower its Defense.

raids.name: Eevee's Gauntlet
raids.blurb: It starts small, then changes again and again. Five forms, one after the other.

raids.name: Trail Warden
raids.blurb: An elite Ursaring guards the middle of the path. It loses its temper quickly.

raids.name: Furnace Keeper
raids.blurb: An elite Magmar heats the whole clearing.

hazard.text: The scorching floor burns your Pokémon!

raids.name: Riddle Golem
raids.blurb: An elite Golurk blocks the way. Only the right pattern of types gets through.

puzzle.text: Runes cover the golem. Hit it with the right types, in order.

raids.name: Magnet Sentry
raids.blurb: An elite Probopass raises a magnetic shield mid-fight.

telegraph.text: The sentry draws power for a heavy hit!

denTriggers.text: Shadow activity has stirred this place up.
A Legendary omen has strange Pokémon gathering.
It is the weekend, and trainers are out hunting dens.
Autumn is the season of the big dens.
Spring brings rival trainers out to the dens.
Word has spread: dens appear more often this far from home.
Your kindness is remembered: a rival is drawn to the den.

gimmickCards.label: Iron Hide
gimmickCards.text: The boss is armoured: 40% more HP. The prize grows by 30%.

gimmickCards.label: Frenzy
gimmickCards.text: It enrages early and keeps growing angrier. The prize grows by 35%.

gimmickCards.label: No Mercy
gimmickCards.text: No healing for either side, but one more draft choice. The prize grows by 25%.

gimmickCards.label: Open Wounds
gimmickCards.text: Weak spots open up (body and core) for a small 10% bonus prize.

talk.prompt: The boss eyes you. What do you say?

choices.label: Speak calmly
choices.reply: It tilts its head. Its guard lowers a little.

next.label: Offer a berry
next.reply: It sniffs the berry and relaxes. Your team feels light on its feet.

next.label: Ask for a fair fight
next.reply: It nods. Both sides stand taller.

choices.label: Taunt it
choices.reply: It roars with fury! Your team is fired up too.

choices.label: Bow to it
choices.reply: It grunts, almost approving. It looks tougher, and so do you.

choices.label: Rally your team
choices.reply: Your team shouts back. The boss waits.

bots.label: Rex the Bruiser (bold)
bots.text: Charges in and hits the boss for 4% of its HP every turn.

bots.label: Shelly the Guard (careful)
bots.text: Stands in front and softens the boss's hits by 15%.

bots.label: Joy the Medic (kind)
bots.text: Mends 8% of your lead's HP every turn.
